environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. CloudFront distribution serves static assets with origin access identity. The Thymeleaf layout decorator (thymeleaf-layout-dialect 3.1) applies a base template that wraps ALL script tags with integrity attributes computed at build time via a Gradle plugin (gradle-sri-hash v2.4.1) that generates a sri-manifest.json. The custom ThymeleafSriDialect processor intercepts th:src resolution and appends integrity='sha384-...' and crossorigin='anonymous' attributes to every <script> element before rendering. Additionally, the response includes a feature-policy header 'sync-xhr none' but notably does NOT include a CSP header with script-src directives. The ALB has a listener rule with a fixed-response action for requests where query string length exceeds 2048 bytes, returning 413. Container memory hard limit is 512MB with ECS task-level resource constraints.

config.load_balancer: ALB with query-string-length listener rule (max 2048, action: fixed-response 413)
